name: Surprised Koala
look: A gray koala clinging beside a tree trunk freezes mid-chew with a green eucalyptus leaf hanging from its mouth, staring at the camera with wide, startled eyes, surrounded by leafy branches.
use: A stunned reaction to something unexpected or outrageous. The caption describes the shocking thing the koala just saw or heard, often catching someone in the middle of eating or doing something.
